episodes.title: Waking Up From a Religious Cult and an Abusive Marriage | Brooke's Story
episodes.description: Episode Title: Unsilenced: Overcoming Religious Cult Trauma, Domestic Abuse, and Finding Inner Peace with Brooke Deanne Episode Overview: In this powerful and deeply moving episode of The LOVE>hate Podcast, host Melissa Etzler sits down with author, transformational coach, and podcast host Brooke Deanne for an intimate conversation on reclaiming one's voice after severe trauma. Born and raised as a third-generation Jehovah's Witness, Brooke candidly shares what it was like growing up inside a high-control religious system, navigating patriarchal family dynamics, and later finding herself trapped in a 17-year abusive marriage that mirrored the control of her upbringing. Brooke walks us through her pivotal "wake-up" moment—from the terrifying turning point that forced her to leave both the religion and the relationship, to the harrowing reality of navigating complex PTSD, trauma bonds, and the total loss of her former community. She opens up about the sudden loss of her children's father in 2020, how grief propelled her into a deeper spiritual journey, and how she ultimately broke free from fear to build an unshakable foundation of self-trust and personal sovereignty. Together, Melissa and Brooke explore non-traditional paths to healing, discussing why traditional talk therapy and medications are sometimes only a starting point, and how somatic healing, Rapid Transformational Therapy (RTT), meditation, and psychedelic-assisted therapy helped Brooke finally experience true safety in her body. This episode is an empowering blueprint for any woman seeking to release victim mindsets, step out of isolation, and rewrite her own story.
